issues.title: Ingest Miller County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $26,109,333 across 52 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($8,707,545), Jail Maintenance & Operation Fund ($5,717,703), Road Department ($4,966,343). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
